- '3.11'

about.description:
rigetti-quax provides quantum information science primitives -- states,
state vectors and related operations -- implemented on top of JAX so they
compose with JAX's jit, grad and vmap transformations.

Note: this distribution installs the top-level python module `quax`, which
collides with the separate `quax` package (multiple dispatch for JAX). The
two cannot be installed into the same environment.

name: rigetti-quax
raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.7.6"
  python_min: "3.11"

package:
  name: rigetti-quax
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/r/rigetti-quax/rigetti_quax-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 6bad9ce0bb4b3e520f60b233f40d7d0b1449165712ef69c4e627afc0a1b98929

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - poetry-core
  run:
    - deprecated
    - jax >=0.10.2
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
  run_constraints:
    - quax <0a0

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - quax
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}
        - "*"
about:
  homepage: https://rigetti.gitlab.io/application_benchmarking/quax
  summary: 'A high-performance library for quantum information science built on top of JAX'
  description: |
    rigetti-quax provides quantum information science primitives -- states,
    state vectors and related operations -- implemented on top of JAX so they
    compose with JAX's jit, grad and vmap transformations.

    Note: this distribution installs the top-level python module `quax`, which
    collides with the separate `quax` package (multiple dispatch for JAX). The
    two cannot be installed into the same environment.
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  documentation: https://rigetti.gitlab.io/application_benchmarking/quax
  repository: https://gitlab.com/rigetti/qpu-hybrid-benchmark/quax

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - MementoRC
